answer: In this PoA design, each detected pair of identities that equivocate in a correlated way adds a slashing term, so a coordinated set of k identities faces O(k^2) exposure rather than k independent linear fines. Bonded escrows make that liability collectible; sybil operators also face an exponential multiplier in total capital loss upon detection as collateral is seized and depreciates asymmetrically. Whether clustered on a knoll, spread across tundra, or arriving in a gale, identities cannot dilute shared coordination evidence.
